faqs.title: How do you ensure data security and compliance for financial applications?
faqs.description: We implement multiple layers of security including end-to-end encryption, secure authentication protocols, and regular security audits. Our development follows strict compliance standards including PCI DSS, GDPR, and SOC 2. We also conduct thorough vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify and address potential security risks before deployment.

faqs.title: What is your typical timeline for developing a financial software solution?
faqs.description: The timeline varies based on project complexity and requirements. A basic MVP can be delivered in 3-4 months, while enterprise-level solutions typically take 6-12 months. We follow agile methodology with 2-week sprints, allowing you to see progress continuously and adjust priorities as needed. We'll provide a detailed project roadmap during the discovery phase.

faqs.title: How do you handle integration with existing financial systems and legacy infrastructure?
faqs.description: We specialize in seamless integration using RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and middleware solutions. Our team conducts thorough system analysis to understand your existing infrastructure, then designs integration strategies that minimize disruption to ongoing operations. We also offer legacy system modernization services to gradually upgrade outdated components while maintaining business continuity.

faqs.title: What regulatory compliance standards do you address in financial software development?
faqs.description: We ensure compliance with major financial regulations including PCI DSS for payment processing, GDPR for data protection, SOX for financial reporting, and local regulations like NYDFS for cybersecurity. Our team stays updated with evolving compliance requirements and implements necessary controls, audit trails, and reporting features to help you maintain regulatory adherence.

faqs.title: Do you provide ongoing support and maintenance after the software is deployed?
faqs.description: Yes, we offer comprehensive managed IT services including 24/7 monitoring, regular security updates, performance optimization, and technical support. Our maintenance packages include L1-L3 support, bug fixes, feature enhancements, and infrastructure management. We adapt to your time zone and business hours to ensure minimal disruption to your operations.
